services.name: airplane charters
services.desc: “Best experience ever!” It has been my moms dream to ride in a biplane and this week we made it happen. A 10 minute trip on the biplane was $40 each but the experience was wonderful. The pilot was very patient with us as we took a hundred pictures and even offered to take some for us then helped us get comfortable in the plane. On the ride, we saw dolphins swimming in the sound below us! I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting the outer banks. My only complaint is that I wish I would have decided to go for longer. :) Visited August

services.name: wild horses
services.desc: “Great people, great pilot, great flight!” We had a great time with Andy! Our tour was beautiful and we highly recommend it as a unique way to see the area! Reviewed September 3,

blurb: Guests soar over the Outer Banks in a 1942 open-cockpit biplane or a Cessna 172. They see dolphins, sea turtles, shipwrecks, the Wright Brothers’ Monument, Bodie Island Lighthouse, and other popular attractions from the air. Tours depart from Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, NC.
extraNote: Dare County Regional Airport in Manteo, just past the NC Aquarium on Airport Road. Turn left once you enter the airport parking lot and look for the big tan hangar.
